question: How is Kaumārī, the mother of the world, addressed when offering worship and salutation?
premises: Kaumārī is addressed as mother of the world.
She is asked to accept worship.
inference: Kaumārī is invoked to accept worship with salutation as the mother of the world.
plain_english: Accept this worship, O Kaumārī, mother of the world; salutation be to you.
